mapper.insert: insert into content_publish_job ( article_id, target_code, status, scheduled_at, started_at, finished_at, operator_id, operator_name, error_message, create_by, update_by, remark, del_flag ) values ( #{articleId}, #{targetCode}, #{status}, #{scheduledAt}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorName}, #{errorMessage}, #{createBy}, #{updateBy}, #{remark}, '0' )
mapper.update:
update content_publish_job
update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, status = #{status}, scheduled_at = #{scheduledAt}, started_at = #{startedAt}, finished_at = #{finishedAt}, operator_id = #{operatorId}, operator_name = #{operatorName}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, update_by = #{updateBy}, remark = #{remark},
where id = #{id} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: select j.id, j.article_id, j.target_code, j.status, j.scheduled_at, j.started_at, j.finished_at, j.operator_id, j.operator_name, j.error_message, a.title as article_title, a.slug as article_slug, a.status as article_status, a.del_flag as article_del_flag, r.id as result_id, r.site_url, r.external_url, j.create_by, j.create_time, j.update_by, j.update_time, j.remark, j.del_flag from content_publish_job j left join content_article a on a.id = j.article_id left join content_publish_result r on r.id = ( select max(r2.id) from content_publish_result r2 where r2.job_id = j.id and r2.del_flag = '0' ) where j.id = #{id} and j.del_flag = '0' order by r.id desc limit 1
